key_insight: SARLO-80 introduces a new worldwide, 80 cm-resolution SAR–language–optical dataset designed to better support multimodal foundation models with physically grounded SAR data. It fills a major gap by preserving richer SAR information than common intensity-only datasets.
problem_solved: The paper addresses the lack of large-scale public SAR datasets for multimodal learning, especially datasets that pair SAR with optical and language data while preserving complex-valued measurements and native acquisition geometry.
method: Builds a worldwide dataset at very-high resolution (80 cm) for SAR, optical, and language alignment.
Preserves complex-valued SAR measurements instead of reducing them to intensity-only GRD products.
Maintains acquisition geometry and physically meaningful metadata to support more realistic multimodal learning and analysis.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, this dataset enables stronger pretraining and benchmarking for multimodal foundation models in remote sensing. It can improve SAR understanding, cross-modal alignment, and downstream tasks that need physically faithful data.
visual_elements: A pipeline diagram showing SAR, optical, and language data alignment

paper_title: SARLO-80: Worldwide Slant SAR Language Optic Dataset 80cm
paper_authors: Solène Debuysère, Nicolas Trouvé, Nathan Letheule, Elise Colin, Georgia Channing
